temporal_notes: Larvae were collected monthly from the field in Dangbo district; exact sampling dates are not reported in the text. Ethical approval was granted in May/June 2015.
source_text: The study was carried in Dangbo located about 60 km from Cotonou... The larvae of the wild An. gambiae s.l. were collected monthly from the field in the district of Dangbo and reared to adult stage at Centre de Recherche Entomologique de Cotonou (CREC).
